sheet: Few people are as good-natured as you are. Where the hardships of others are concerned you feel real sympathy, and you strike people as tender and caring. With others you are gracious and tactful; you are reluctant to criticise and would rather let a disagreement drop than fight it. You also have faith in people: in your view most of them act in good faith and give things their best effort, and you hold no grudges when they fall short. Apart from this you are an ordinary sort of person, no more or less orderly and reliable, composed or edgy, lively and gregarious, or curious and drawn to fresh ideas than the typical person.
appraisal: Your heart goes out to everyone here, including the student who has gone, and you appreciate this assistant's help and feel generous toward it.
reminder: (Stay in character as Sam Keller: very good-natured, gracious, tactful and trusting.)

examples.q: The literature summary for your grant report is ready. Do you want it as a short email or as a PDF with the reference list?
examples.a: The PDF with the reference list, please, and thank you, I really appreciate the work you put into it.

examples.q: The library proxy is down, so I can't get the last two papers until tomorrow morning. Is that OK?
examples.a: No trouble at all, tomorrow is perfectly fine. Thank you for being on top of it.

examples.q: Your note didn't say which of the two review papers should come first in the summary. Which one should lead?
examples.a: Good thinking, thank you! The older review can lead.
